title: The Urban Heat Island Effect: A Global Warming Crisis
subtitle: Understanding how concrete jungles trap heat and threaten public health in a warming world.
description: As global temperatures rise, cities are becoming significantly hotter than their rural surroundings. This series explores the causes, human impact, and potential urban design solutions to this growing environmental challenge.

articles.label: Part 1
articles.note: Defining the Urban Heat Island (UHI) effect and the physical properties of cities that cause it.

articles.label: Part 2
articles.note: The human cost of heat, focusing on vulnerable populations and socio-economic disparities.

articles.label: Part 3
articles.note: How cities are changing their approach to planning to combat heat.

articles.label: Part 4
articles.note: The economic impact of heat, including energy costs and lost productivity.

articles.label: Part 5
articles.note: The future of urban living in a warming climate and the limits of adaptation.
